coverage_claim: A source-grounded reviewable draft of a legal instrument and its source-linked norms across Akoma Ntoso, LegalRuleML, ELI, PROV-O, OWL-Time and SKOS, without universal substantive-law, legal-advice, binding-interpretation or certified crosswalk claims.

boundary_decision.status: accepted only with separable legal-work, expression, manifestation, source, provision and norm identities
boundary_decision.rationale: The combined catalogue identity is useful when source and norm must travel together, but a file, legal source, natural-language provision and formal norm remain separately attributable objects. Organizations, procedures, cases, enforcement events, parties, places and generic repositories stay external masters.

decisions.rationale: A legal instrument and its expressed norms may share one package only when work, expression, manifestation, authoritative source, provision and norm identifiers never collapse.
Publication, signature, seal, register and digest evidence are preserved, but legal authority is never inferred from availability or file integrity alone.
Every structured or executable rule cites exact source fragments, author, method, version and confidence and cannot silently replace the legal text.
Adoption, publication, validity, force, efficacy, applicability, observation and knowledge time can differ by provision and jurisdiction.
Original, modifying and correcting acts remain distinct, while every consolidated view records applied sources, cutoff and unresolved conflicts.
Static and dynamic citations identify target work or provision, version rule, language and resolution result rather than relying on rendered numbering.
Priority, override, derogation, exception, guidance and holdings remain authority-qualified assertions and do not become automatic legal advice.
Akoma Ntoso, LegalRuleML, ELI and W3C vocabularies serve different purposes, so mappings pin versions and disclose source, semantic and round-trip loss.
The approved relation ledger contains no WM-POL-001 rows, so proposed links to organizations, processes, cases, events, parties, places and document masters remain draft.
